title: a ticket queues itself at a far box's gate by its id, not this box's path
intention: Ticket.queueme names the ticket to the gate by its id, so a gate on another box resolves it from that box's own commons; a doc with no id still sends its path.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: sail.py chart ee88c2126abc on akienasus, its bus home on akiendelllinux, was refused 'codemother verb machines/orient/queueme handler raised NotImplementedError: Non-relative patterns are unsupported': the ticket sent akienasus's absolute plan path, the far box could not open it, and find_ticket globbed it.
traces_to: The ticket intention (outline 3.3.4.3: a ticket crosses a gate by sending its fileref; the gate instantiates the ticket on its own side) and Law 1 (a crossing lane that only works on one box re-derives nothing but costs a lane).
how: ticket.py queueme sends {'fileref': self.id or self.fileref}. 152d76785229's tooth 1 expects the id. A red-first proof captures the body through a spy and resolves it with Ticket.at in a scratch far store after the sender's store is gone.

clauses.claim: Ticket.queueme's request body is {'fileref': <the ticket's id>}, never a path
on a far box, where the sender's absolute plan path does not exist and the far store holds a copy of the plan, Ticket.at over what queueme sent resolves to the far copy with the same id

decisions.text: D1: queueme sends the ticket's id as the fileref, falling back to the plan path when the doc carries no id.

D2: every proof that pinned the plan path in the queueme body expects the id: tickets 152d76785229 and cd8a1de6139c (cairn/machines/ticket), the sail proof (cairn/devices/cc) and the chart skill's proof (skills/chart). An id is a fileref: the gate's own refusal text says 'the ticket's plan path or id'. Each was green before and red after D1 alone (measured 2026-11-12).
D3: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause, in scratch sender and far stores.

out: cairn/tools/base/ticket_file.py (find_ticket's absolute-name crash is not this ticket's)

measured.how: python3 cairn/devices/cc/scripts/sail.py chart ee88c2126abc on akienasus, CAIRN_BUS_HOME=akiendelllinux.local:7419; the gate_dialog line in that ticket's log.jsonl (commons b2c92989)

measured.saw: queueme sends {'fileref': self.fileref}, the absolute plan path; find_ticket globs f'*-{name}.json'
